message.content: {"question": "An aluminum block of mass m₁ = 0.1 Kg at temperature T₁ = 580 K is immersed in a glass vessel of mass m₂ = 0.2 Kg and having temperature equal to T₂ = 300 K. The glass vessel containing a mass of water equal to m₃ = 0.5 Kg to the temperature of 300 K. Disregarding the exchange of heat with the outside environment, determine the equilibrium temperature T_F of the system. The specific heats of aluminum, glass and water are c₁ = 896.0 J/Kg K, c₂ = 630.4 J/Kg K and c₃ = 4187.0 J/Kg K.", "options": {"A": "T_F = 410.86 K", "B": "T_F = 440.00 K", "C": "T_F = 310.86 K", "D": "T_F = 390.66 K"}, "correct": "C"}
